feature_count.explanation: Typo in early Phase 1 narrative text. Exactly 28 numeric features exist in FEATURE_COLUMNS, the manifest, and glycotwin_features.parquet.

task_a_positive_count.explanation: Phase 0 narrative report cited 30,192 as an unverified manual approximation (309,242 * 9.76%). The exact sum of target-eligible positives in phase0_data_audit.json was 27,729. When excluding the 12 warmup steps per participant (is_modelling_eligible == True), the exact positive count is 27,661.

task_b_onset_count.explanation: Phase 0 reported 8,761 over all target-eligible windows. When excluding the 12 warmup steps per participant (is_modelling_eligible == True), exactly 8,742 onset events remain.

leakage_audit.temporal_directionality: Strictly backward-looking (lags k > 0, trailing right-aligned rolling windows)
leakage_audit.future_alteration_test: PASS (Mutating future glucose does not alter current feature vector)
leakage_audit.preprocessor_fitting: PASS (StandardScaler fitted strictly on training fold X_train inside scikit-learn Pipeline)
leakage_audit.group_kfold_isolation: PASS (Zero participant overlap between train and validation folds)

personalisation_audit.description: The initial Phase 2 implementation split calibration and evaluation at index n_calib without a purge gap. The final 6 calibration rows had 30-minute target windows overlapping into the evaluation segment. A 30-minute purge gap (5-6 rows per participant) was implemented and verified, completely eliminating horizon overlap.
personalisation_audit.adaptation_mechanism: Platt scaling (1D Logistic Regression on population log-odds)
personalisation_audit.mathematical_effect: Monotonic transformation of log-odds. Ranking metrics (ROC-AUC, Average Precision) are strictly invariant (delta ~ 0.0000). Probability calibration is substantially improved (Brier score improves across all 24 adapted participants) by correcting for population class-weight probability distortion.
personalisation_audit.threshold_scaling_interaction: Previously, applying the population threshold (~0.50) to Platt-recalibrated probabilities (~0.03) collapsed F1 score (-0.42). Adapting the decision threshold via the adapter function preserves the intended classification decision boundary while delivering well-calibrated probabilities.
personalisation_audit.insufficient_data_handling: HUPA0009P (0 positive events) handled gracefully via fallback_to_population, preserving all 25 participants in reporting.

caveats_and_limitations: Cohort size is limited to 25 adult Type 1 diabetes participants from a single clinical center.
Platt scaling personalisation modifies probability calibration but does not alter sample ranking (ROC-AUC delta is zero).
Clinical alert thresholds must be mapped in tandem with calibrated probabilities to prevent sensitivity suppression.
